attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 18, 2026, titled "Press Release   Receipt of Work Orders Aggregating Rs. 234.83 Crore".
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited secured three work orders aggregating Rs. 234.83 crore inclusive of GST. The orders cover infrastructure development and road maintenance projects in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Andhra Pradesh. Two orders from RKEC Projects Limited total Rs. 178.12 crore. These include bridge construction valued at Rs. 120.28 crore and highway rehabilitation worth Rs. 57.84 crore. A third order from Ranastalam Anandapuram Road Limited is valued at Rs. 56.71 crore. The company's unexecuted order book now stands at approximately Rs. 800 crore. The announcement was filed on 18th November 2026.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited filed an investors presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 86.02 Cr for Q2 FY27, up 10.75% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 11.34 Cr with a margin of 13.18%. Profit after tax was Rs. 4.95 Cr, reflecting a 21.21% year-on-year increase. Earnings per share were Rs. 2.23. For the half year, revenue reached Rs. 161.88 Cr and PAT was Rs. 9.31 Cr. The unexecuted order book stood at Rs. 624.22 Cr as of September 30, 2026. The board approved the amalgamation of Markolines Infra Limited into the company on March 6, 2026, with SEBI clearance obtained. The presentation was uploaded to the company website.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Analyst/Investor meeting
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has scheduled a post earnings conference call for analysts and investors on Thursday, 19th November, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. IST. The call will discuss the standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Participation details are available via the link https://tinyurl.com/284t95nf and on the company website www.markolines.com. The schedule is subject to change. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. The intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about wi the Company's intimation dated 16th November 2026 submitted to the Stock Exchanges. Please find enclosed herewith a corrigendum to the said intimation, correcting the description of the first two orders received from RKEC Projects Limited from "Letter of Award" to "Work Order". All other details of the original intimation remain unchanged.
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited issued a corrigendum to its intimation dated 16th November 2026 regarding the receipt of multiple work orders for infrastructure and road maintenance projects. The company clarified that two documents from RKEC Projects Limited, previously referred to as Letter of Award, are actually Work Orders. The corrections apply only to the document description and do not alter the underlying particulars, including the awarding entity, scope of work, order value, execution period, or other terms. All other information in the original intimation remains unchanged. The corrigendum was signed by Sanjay Patil, Chairman and Managing Director, with DIN 00229050229050.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited received work orders from domestic entities for infrastructure projects. RKEC Projects Limited awarded a sub-contract for bridge construction on NH-04 in Andaman and Nicobar Islands with a consideration of Rs. 1,20,28,26,390 including GST, to be executed in 18 months. RKEC Projects Limited also awarded a sub-contract for road rehabilitation on NH-04 in Andaman and Nicobar Islands with a consideration of Rs. 57,83,93,010 including GST, to be executed in 6 months. Ranastalam Anandapuram Road Limited awarded a work order for major maintenance and road overlay in Andhra Pradesh with a consideration of Rs. 56,71,15,344 including GST, to be executed in 180 days. The company confirmed that promoters have no interest in the awarding entities and these are not related party transactions.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited Reports Financial Performance for Q2 & H1 FY27".
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 86.02 crore, EBITDA was Rs. 11.34 crore, and PAT was Rs. 4.95 crore. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 161.88 crore, EBITDA was Rs. 20.51 crore, and PAT was Rs. 9.31 crore. The company secured two work orders from the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation aggregating to Rs. 135.20 crore. The total current unexecuted order book stands at Rs. 624.22 crore. Mr. Sanjay Patil is the Chairman and Managing Director with DIN 00229052.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited held a Board Meeting on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory auditors Jay Gupta & Associates issued Limited Review Reports on the financial statements. The reports stated that nothing came to their attention to suggest material misstatements in the results prepared under Indian Accounting Standards. The consolidated results include financial information for associate Uniqueuhpc Markolines LLP and joint venture Markolines Evrascon JV. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Uniqueuhpc Markolines LLP reported revenue of Rs. 1976.68 lakhs and a profit after tax of Rs. 116.01 lakhs. Markolines Evrascon JV reported revenue of Rs. 2194.67 lakhs and a profit after tax of Rs. 79.54 lakhs. The company has filed these results with BSE and NSE pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 05, 2026, titled "Please find attached the Press Release issued by Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited regarding the receipt of work orders from Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for road resurfacing works using microsurfacing technology on the Eastern Express Highway and Western Express Highway, aggregating to approximately ₹135.20 Crores.".

Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited ( the Company ) is pleased to inform that it has received two Letters of Acceptance-cum-Work Orders from Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) for undertaking microsurfacing works on the Eastern Express Highway and Western Express Highway, Mumbai, aggregating to ₹135.20 Crores.The detailed disclosure pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 is enclosed herewith.
